name: field
title: Field
description: Label, control and help or error text for text inputs, selects, textareas and search boxes. 36px controls with a gold focus ring.
whenToUse: Every form control. Wrap the control in tx-field so label, help and error stay consistent. Use tx-field--inline for a label beside the control.

variants.description: Text, number, email, password, date inputs.
Native select with the themed chevron.
Input with a leading icon or a trailing unit.
Red border and message; set aria-invalid on the control.
28px control for tables and dense filters.

a11y: Every control has a <label for>. Help and error text are linked with aria-describedby. Required fields use the required attribute and show '*' in the label.
